notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a card using Lurrus this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Restoration Angel, adding {C}{C}.
When Restoration Angel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it returns Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Repeat.
